data.name: Second Stone
data.detailed_description:
Second Stone revives the color, warmth and wonder of gaming's golden age, rebuilt with modern technology, deep systems and fluid gameplay. A vibrant Action RPG with platforming at its heart, following Shiren, a young treasure hunter from the village of Arimaya, on a journey that spans two realities.

WALK BETWEEN TWO PARALLEL WORLDS

Travel seamlessly between the vibrant Light World, full of life and adventure, and its dark mirror, the Shrouded World, where secrets, dangers and vicious monsters await. Both worlds are fully playable and deeply connected. A blocked path in the Light World may open in the Shrouded World. A peaceful clearing may hide something sinister on its shadowed side. Worldwalking is your greatest power and the key to everything Second Stone has to offer.

EXPLORE A VAST, INTERCONNECTED WORLD

Discover lush environments and charming characters across a vast world where every region connects. New abilities unlock new routes and hidden paths, and every area rewards curiosity twice: once in the light, once in the shadow.

A FUSION OF PLATFORMING AND ACTION RPG

Imagine your favorite platformer armed with swords, spells, loot and skill trees. Second Stone combines fast, precise movement with real-time combat that scales from approachable to genuinely deep. Level up through the Astral Tablet, unlock talents and shape a fighting style that is entirely your own.

GET CREATIVE TO BECOME TRULY POWERFUL

Find elemental Manastones and attach them to your weapons and gear to unlock powerful effects. Need to freeze enemies at range? Socket a Rimestone into your bow. Want to become a storm mage? A Sparkstone in your magical bracer will do it. Fuse surplus Manastones to upgrade your loadout and customize your spells exactly the way you want: make your Fireball split into three projectiles, home in on its targets or detonate on impact. Combine the endlessly modular Manastone system with weapons, gear and the Astral Tablet skill tree to create thousands of character builds limited only by your imagination.

CONQUER THE LOST LABYRINTHS

Deep within the world lie massive temples with procedural, rogue-like gameplay. Test your build-crafting skills in repeatable runs and face the brutally challenging Depth Bosses waiting below.

A WORLD WORTH RETURNING TO

Between adventures, return to Arimaya Village to upgrade your gear, follow treasure hunts and challenge villagers to Mana Clash, the dice-battler card minigame. And behind it all waits an epic story: a boy born without a spirit guardian, a stolen Stone of legend whose power holds both worlds in balance, and a journey to reclaim it before the two realities collide. 

 

KEY FEATURES 

  • Two Parallel Worlds: Walk between the vibrant Light World and its perilous dark mirror, the Shrouded World, hunting for rare artifacts and uncovering the secrets hidden within both realms 

  • High-Mobility Action-RPG Combat: Master fast-paced combat defined by dynamic movement, fluid platforming, and environmental puzzles that keep the action evolving 

  • Modular Build Customization: Express your creativity by fusing elemental Manastones to craft unique powers, then slot them into your gear to design a combat style entirely your own 

  • Ever-Changing Labyrinth Dungeons: Enter the Lost Labyrinths, procedural rogue-like gauntlets that offer fresh layouts and repeatable challenges for those seeking the rarest rewards 

  • Bustling Village Hub: Return to Arimaya Village to upgrade your gear, chat with locals for quests, and unwind with Mana Clash, the dice-battler card minigame 

  • An Epic Tale of Two Realities: A boy born without a spirit guardian, a stolen Stone of legend, and a journey to restore the balance before both worlds collide

data.short_description: Second Stone is a colorful Action RPG built around two fully playable parallel worlds. Play as Shiren, a young treasure hunter who can cross between the vibrant Light World and its sinister mirror, the Shrouded World. Master fast-paced combat and forge your path to power with elemental Manastones.
data.supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian
*languages with full audio support
